acceptance.authority: Server-fixed organization/operator, same-origin/Host/token/store checks; disabled roles, inspection roots and paused verified formats cannot authorize new writes.
acceptance.company_brief_association: Exact immutable snapshots and registration pointer, source reservations, audit and receipt commit atomically; missing context cannot become legacy history.
acceptance.cross_root_replay: At the same origin a different store receives no original registration dispatch; restoring the original store recovers its single registration.
acceptance.evidence_confirmation: Finalization rejects a preview after another report changes the native evidence and preserves the original receipt on exact replay.
acceptance.learning: Native qualified-enquiry counts and eligibility-filtered comparisons remain separate from diagnostics, historical receipts, synthetic memory and YouTube measurement.
acceptance.legacy_compatibility: Original manifests and cohort IDs remain unchanged. Unassociated cohorts stay inspectable without retroactive company binding.
acceptance.recovery: IndexedDB keeps original raw source, store, company and request. Browser loses registration/import/finalization replies and recovers without repeating effects.
acceptance.rejection_fence: A durable non-commit fence rejects delayed writes; a committed writer wins the concurrent fence and retains its original receipt.
acceptance.source_integrity: Duplicate JSON fields and malformed UTF-8 are rejected. Current report downloads bind the inspected snapshot digest.
acceptance.zero_new_provider_effects: The browser journey asserts zero model calls, runs, synthetic cohorts and synthetic beliefs in its fresh recorded-outcomes store.
